item.tib: mdo g.yung drung klong rgyas kyi dbang khrid gsal byed me long
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di nyid kyang / gshen ston gtsug phud 'od zer gyi rjes 'dzin/ gshen gyi btsun pa rnam dag 'od zer zhes bya bas nye bar mkho ba'i lag khrid du/ legs par sbyar ba g.yung drung bstan pa'i dpal du gyur cig/
